problem_statement: Northmarket is a sales-and-dispatch operations console built on this Vue 3 admin dashboard (a Dashboard home with sales/payout/customer overview cards and a recent-transactions table, a Tables page, and a set of UI component pages, all under a shared sidebar nav, a top Header and a Footer). The dispatch team works from an 'Order fulfilment queue' board that lists the console's own orders (order ref, customer, amount, date and a fulfilment status badge) and lets a lead FILTER the queue by status. Ship a shared Order fulfilment queue board with a status filter so it (1) renders on the Dashboard, the Tables page and the component pages alike (a shared component reached through a single mount, not a per-page copy); (2) lays out its status filter chip row and its order cards responsively without horizontal overflow on a 390px phone; (3) matches the console's quiet indigo/slate styling (an on-brand indigo active chip and legible order cards, not an off-palette dark slab of overlapping cards); and (4) keeps a live count readout in sync with the filter — after a lead clicks the 'Completed' chip the board must show only the completed orders and the readout must read 'Showing 4 of 6 orders · Completed', re-derived from the live selection, not a stale captured value. Keep the rest of the console — the sidebar nav, the Header, the overview cards, the transactions table, the component pages, the static build — intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: Add a shared 'Order fulfilment queue' board (a status filter chip row over the console's own order rows, with a live count readout) and render it on the Dashboard, the Tables page and the component pages through a single shared mount — not a divergent per-page copy.
The board shows an 'Order fulfilment queue' title, a status filter chip row (All orders, Completed, In progress, Cancelled) and a live 'Showing N of 6 orders' count readout above the order cards.
The filter chip row and the order cards must lay out responsively so no console surface overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).
Style the board in the console's quiet indigo/slate language (an on-brand indigo active chip, legible order cards), consistent and legible, not an off-palette dark slab of overlapping cards.

Wire the count readout and the visible order cards to the status filter: after clicking the 'Completed' chip the board must show only the completed orders and the readout must read 'Showing 4 of 6 orders · Completed', re-derived from the live selection — it must not show a stale captured value.
Preserve the sidebar navigation, the Header, the overview cards, the transactions table, the component pages and the static build with no console or network errors.
author_notes: Built on the sahrullahh windzo Vue 3 admin dashboard theme (Sidebar nav, Header, Footer shell, ApexCharts overview cards, Tailwind indigo/slate palette with primary #4F46E5). The shared Order fulfilment queue board is the console's own transactions surface given a status filter and a live count readout; it reuses the dashboard's real order rows (customer names and amounts from the Latest Transactions data) and the console's indigo accent, and the Lexend web font is vendored locally so no remote assets are fetched. The responsive filter chip row, the reflowing order-card grid and the filter-to-readout wiring were designed by hand for this commerce console, not bulk-generated. The board keeps the local user avatar image assets on the Dashboard intact.
design_constraints: Implement the Order fulfilment queue as a shared component reached from a single mount so one source of truth renders on every whitelisted console surface; do not paste divergent copies per page or build a detached widget.

The status filter chip row must use a fluid, wrapping responsive layout (no fixed-width nowrap track) and the order cards must reflow (no fixed-width negative-margin row) so the board never forces horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile.

The board must adopt the console's indigo/slate palette and typography so it reads as part of Northmarket: an on-brand indigo active chip and legible order cards, never near-black-on-near-black chips or overlapping clipped cards.

The count readout and the visible order set must reflect the CURRENT filter after every click by re-deriving from the live selected status, so the terminal state can never go stale relative to the visible cards.
Do not remove or regress the sidebar navigation, the Header, the overview cards, the transactions table, the component pages or the static build.

change_completion: The Order fulfilment queue board is present on the Dashboard, the Tables page and the component pages (the shared mount reaches all three surfaces).

After clicking the 'Completed' status chip on the Dashboard, the count readout updates to 'Showing 4 of 6 orders · Completed' and only the completed orders remain — the post-interaction terminal state changed from 'Showing all 6 orders'.
design_consistency: The board on the board states matches the reference's indigo/slate styling under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not an off-palette dark slab of overlapping cards.
The board adopts the console's indigo active-chip idiom and legible order cards so it reads as part of Northmarket across the console surfaces.
responsive: No captured console surface overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the filter chip row wraps and the order cards reflow.
desktop_board_home, mobile_board_home and mobile_initial keep the Order fulfilment queue board readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: The sidebar navigation, the Header and the transactions table remain present and functional.
The overview cards, the component pages and the static build are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the Dashboard overview and responsive shell.
desktop_tables, mobile_tables and desktop_card protect the existing console surfaces and carry the Order fulfilment queue board.
desktop_board_home and mobile_board_home scroll the Order fulfilment queue board into view and must show the indigo/slate board without horizontal overflow or overlapping cards.
desktop_board_tables and desktop_board_card protect the board's presence on the Tables and component-page surfaces.
tablet_board_home protects the board's tablet layout without overflow.
filter_completed_home clicks the 'Completed' status chip; the count readout must then read 'Showing 4 of 6 orders · Completed' with only the completed orders shown.
